text: make a carousel with focus tips
withheld: Each slide should be portrait, four units wide by five units tall.

Use these exact tips in this order: Clear your desk; Silence notifications; Pick one task; Set a timer; Take a short break.
Include a small illustration matching each tip.
Do not include a cover or closing slide.
No extra text beyond each tip and its number.
